about: Written for this test: a US budget-blog style card (prices, metric repeats, a spice mix the steps call by one name, a can after a size).
name: Smoky Chicken Skillet Pasta
ingredients: 15 oz. can (400 g) fire roasted diced tomatoes (with juices, $1.23)
steps: Cut the chicken breast into ¾ inch pieces and dice the onion.
Toss the chicken with the smoky spice mix in a bowl until every piece is coated.

Add the olive oil and butter to a deep skillet. Heat the oil and butter over medium-high until the butter is foamy. Add the chicken and cook for a couple minutes, just until the outside gets some color.
Add the onion and keep sautéing for about 3 minutes more, until the onion begins to soften.
Add the pasta, diced tomatoes (with their juices), and chicken broth. Stir until combined, then place a lid on top and let the broth come up to a boil.
Once boiling, remove the lid, turn the heat down to medium-low and simmer for about ten minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Add the cream cheese in chunks, then stir until it has melted into the sauce. Top the pasta with the green onions and serve.
